title: 第3章 灵武巅峰塑根基第4章 是死是活凭个人
content_zh:
天雷峰。
长老府邸。
死而复生的林玄坐于椅子上被丹脉众弟子围观。大腹便便的祝天虹八字胡一撇，把他们都赶了出去之后，自己独自欣赏。
脸上表情颇为复杂，带有欣喜更有诧异，脚不断的踱来踱去，全方位打量着林玄，口中还不停的重复。
“奇迹啊……奇迹……”
……
半晌后。
当林玄说出自己丹田修复了，祝天虹再次被震惊，满脸不可置信的表情。最后探查了一番，才终于相信，略微思索点头道：
“看来是大难不死，必有后福！这丹田剑气如虹，灵气充沛，剑道资质不错！”
祝天虹满意说着，突然想起刚刚林玄说的话，摸着自己的八字胡，颇为不解道：
“不过玄儿啊，你刚刚说想学炼丹？可你这丹田修炼剑道最佳，为何要跟为师学炼丹？”
“徒儿对丹道颇有兴趣。”
林玄当然是为了炼制自己的剑丹，面对祝天虹的询问没说出真正原因。
闻言，祝天虹点点头，也没再追问，只是嘱咐道：
“玄儿，你想学为师自然不会存私，只不过，你得答应为师，你这剑道天赋万不可辜负啊。”
林玄点头回答说道：
“师傅放心，必不会影响武道修炼。”
这时候，祝红菱从外面走了进来，美眸颇为诧异的看向旁边的林玄，表情跟刚刚的祝天虹差不多。
“菱儿，你来的正好，你师兄丹田已经恢复了！只不过目前实力低微，需要大量的资源与历练。对了，你不是接了门派任务过几日要组队前往百兽林吗？你组队的时候带一下你师兄。”
祝天虹摸着八字胡笑着说道，拍了拍林玄的肩膀。

林玄诧异，刚刚他只是提了一下说要帮忙安排一下去宗门百兽林历练，主要目的是为了凑齐剑丹炼制的草药，没想到师傅居然直接让师妹带他。
而一旁的祝红菱听着父亲的话，俏眉微皱，看向林玄的目光更是露出了一丝鄙视，不管什么宗门，人家都是师兄带师妹，哪有要师妹带师兄去历练的，到时候组队的那几个师兄师妹岂不是又要笑话自己？
只不过，父亲祝天虹的话她不敢违背，只好不太情愿的回答，道：
“哦，知道了。”
对于女儿的敷衍与不满之意，祝天虹自然看在眼里，没有去理会。
他看好林玄，一个能坚持八年雷劈历练的人，成就如何会低！？而且这次林玄死而复生，更是丹田修复好了，剑道资质极其出众。这一切，更加让祝天虹觉得自己八年前的选择是对的！
林玄，必不是池中之物！
祝天虹心中的想法不露于色，摸着八字胡离开了府邸内。
content_en:
Tianleifeng.
The elder's mansion.
Lin Xuan, who had come back from the dead, was sitting on a chair and was surrounded by Danmai disciples. The fat-bellied Zhu Tianhong curled up his mustache, drove them all out, and admired it by himself.
The expression on his face was quite complicated, ranging from joy to surprise. He kept pacing back and forth, looking at Lin Xuan from all directions, and kept repeating.
"A miracle...a miracle..."
…
After a while.
When Lin Xuan said that his Dantian had been repaired, Zhu Tianhong was shocked again, with an expression of disbelief on his face. After a final investigation, I finally believed it, thought for a while and nodded:
"It seems that if you survive a catastrophe, you will be blessed later! The sword energy in your Dantian is like a rainbow, full of spiritual energy, and you have good swordsmanship!"
Zhu Tianhong said with satisfaction, and suddenly remembered what Lin Xuan said just now, touched his mustache, and said in confusion:
"But Xuan'er, you just said you wanted to learn alchemy? But your Dantian is the best at swordsmanship, so why do you want to learn alchemy from my master?"
"My disciple is very interested in Alchemy."
Of course Lin Xuan wanted to refine his own sword elixir, but he did not tell the real reason when faced with Zhu Tianhong's inquiry.
Hearing this, Zhu Tianhong nodded and did not ask any more questions. He just asked:
"Xuan'er, if you want to learn to be a teacher, you won't be selfish. However, you have to agree to become a teacher. You must not let down your talent in swordsmanship."
Lin Xuan nodded and replied:
"Master, don't worry, it will not affect your martial arts practice."
At this time, Zhu Hongling walked in from the outside, and looked at Lin Xuan next to her in surprise, with an expression similar to that of Zhu Tianhong just now.
"Ling'er, you came just in time. Your senior brother's Dantian has recovered! But his current strength is low and requires a lot of resources and experience. By the way, didn't you accept the sect's mission and form a team to go to the Beast Forest in a few days? When you form the team, take your senior brother with you."
Zhu Tianhong touched his mustache and said with a smile, patting Lin Xuan on the shoulder.
Lin Xuan was surprised. Just now he just mentioned that he would help arrange a training trip to the sect's Beast Forest. The main purpose was to collect the herbs for refining the sword pill. Unexpectedly, the master actually asked his junior sister to take him.
On the side, Zhu Hongling frowned slightly as she listened to her father's words, and looked at Lin Xuan with a hint of contempt. No matter what sect, the senior brothers lead the junior sisters. How could a junior sister take a senior brother to practice? Wouldn't the senior brothers and sisters who formed the team have to laugh at herself again?
However, she did not dare to violate her father Zhu Tianhong's words, so she had to answer reluctantly, saying:
"Oh, got it."
Zhu Tianhong naturally saw his daughter's perfunctory and dissatisfied expression and ignored it.
He was optimistic about Lin Xuan, a person who could persist in eight years of lightning strike experience, how could his achievements be so low! ? Moreover, this time Lin Xuan came back from the dead, his Dantian was repaired, and his swordsmanship was extremely outstanding. All this made Zhu Tianhong feel that his choice eight years ago was right!
Lin Xuan must not be a thing in the pond!
Zhu Tianhong kept his thoughts in mind and left the mansion stroking his mustache.
